integrity: Finite exhaustive line and point incidence enumeration by two independently coded methods in the included complete source file; exact finite-field arithmetic; no independence or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for smooth nondegenerate diagonal cubics in projective 4-space over F_7 and projective equivalence over F_7. Does not address arbitrary smooth cubic threefolds, abstract isomorphism, or other base fields. Earlier Jacobi-sum results may yield related formulas.
title: Exact rational point-line incidence profiles of diagonal cubic threefolds over \(\mathbf F_7\)
